messages:
Ava (docs): FYI I opened PR #5102 to rework the migration guide and replace the old sync embed example with the streaming SDK snippet. Also removed an outdated cross-link. Please eyeball the examples when you have a minute.
Ben (platform): thanks Ava. can you paste the CI/docs preview link when it's ready so I can sanity-check the anchors? last time an anchor change broke the TOC.
Ava (docs): will do. quick note 0min ago I spotted a literal KMS ARN in the snippet from a copied test file. snippet here that needs redaction before we can merge:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(kms_key="arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:987654321098:key/1a2b3c4d5e6f")
resp = client.stream("Generate something")
```
Chris (sdk): yep please redact. we usually use PLACEHOLDER_KMS_ARN in examples but it's fine to use the canonical `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID` too.
Sam (security): tagged. please open an RD ticket for the sensitive-docs flow and link the PR. I can triage today. remember to mark confidentiality as "example-credentials".
Ava (docs): opened RD-88 and added the PR link. filed a quick note asking for an expedited review.
sensitive-docs-bot: redaction request RD-88 created for PR #5102  status: pending triage 
docs-preview-bot: preview build queued for PR #5102  https://ci.example.com/builds/5102
Ben (platform): CI shows an HTML anchor warning in the build logs, likely from the changed heading slug. I can patch the TOC in a follow-up but would rather not block this small fix.
Maria (legal): quick read: if code references key material, we need a one-line advisory reminding readers not to paste production credentials into examples or CI logs. I can propose wording: "Do not paste live keys or credentials into examples or public CI logs; use placeholders."
Ava (docs): added Maria's advisory as a short callout and replaced the literal ARN with `arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY_ID`. pushed the change.
docs-preview-bot: preview build failed for PR #5102  failing check: docs-lint (link-check) 
Ava (docs): hmm link-check is failing on an internal api-ref link that changed slug. Ben said he'd follow up, but can we bypass link-check for this one commit?
Sam (security): don't bypass CI. if it's just a broken anchor, fix the slug or add a redirect. Security won't sign off on merges that skip link checks for docs that mention keys.
Chris (sdk): quick local test: the preview container sometimes caches old node_modules which causes link-check false positives. I can run the preview locally and push a clean build if you want.
Ben (platform): Chris, could you run it and post the new preview URL? I can also regenerate the link-check index from the platform side.
Chris (sdk): running now locally, rebuilding site. give me ~10m.
sensitive-docs-bot: RD-88 status updated  security review complete, pending legal confirmation.
Chris (sdk): local preview passed link-checks. temporary preview: http://local-preview.example/5102 (internal only)
Maria (legal): reviewed the advisory and the PR changes. left one tiny phrasing suggestion (reduce "must not" to "should not" for tone). otherwise okay.
Sam (security): good from security after the placeholder swap and RD ticket. :thumbsup:
Ava (docs): updated wording per Maria. pinging for final ack. can we merge during the scheduled docs merge window tomorrow at 09:30 PT if legal gives the green light?
Maria (legal): fine to merge in that window. I'll add a short comment in the PR approving legal language.
Ben (platform): once merged can we also open a sweep ticket to scan examples repo-wide for any discovered ARNs/credentials? I can own that.
Ava (docs): thanks all. planning to merge in the 09:30 PT window after legal approves. will add a note to release notes about the migration guide changes.
docs-preview-bot: deploy event: docs site update queued for main (PR #5102)  will publish after merge.
